about: Country cards for lives born in Japan. Each card is dealt only to them (and a little more often than general cards). Sources are in each card's "src".

events.src: ===================== Japan (JP) ===================== Shūkatsu: firms hire new graduates together each April after job-hunting in the third and fourth years (Keidanren and government schedule guidelines). Large firms' layoff rarity, seniority pay and costs are game rules and ESTIMATES.

opts.do: spend('jp_shukatsu', .04 * B, 'trk.jp_shukatsu'); happy -= 3; layM = .35; ppM = (ppM || 1) * .8; bump('jp_big', 1.06, M('trk.jp_big'))
spend('jp_shukatsu', .015 * B, 'trk.jp_shukatsu')
spend('jp_gap', .3 * B, 'trk.jp_gap'); happy += 5; addSkill('gap', 2, M('trk.jp_gap')); layM = 1.15; jobAt = study.end + 1

en..x: Japanese firms hire new graduates together every April. Job-hunting fills your third and fourth years: company briefings, a black suit, written tests and many rounds of interviews. Large firms rarely lay people off and raise pay with seniority, but their doors are hardest to open once you miss this window.
en..big: Go all out for a large firm
en..big.s: About {a} on suits, travel and tests, and months of interviews. Happiness −3.
en..big.h: In a large firm, layoffs are much rarer and pay a little higher, but promotions come slowly.
en..small: Apply to smaller firms and start-ups too
en..gap.s: About {a}, and you start work a year later. Happiness +5.
en..gap.h: Skill +2; employers are a little less loyal to late starters.

zh..x: 日本企业每年四月统一录用应届毕业生。大三大四都在求职：企业说明会、黑色西装、笔试和一轮又一轮的面试。大公司很少裁员，工资按年资上涨，但错过这个时机，大门就很难再打开。
zh..big.s: 西装、路费和考试约{a}，面试好几个月。幸福感 −3。
zh..big.h: 在大公司被裁员的机会小得多，工资略高，但升职慢。
zh..small: 中小企业和创业公司也投
zh..small.h: 裁员和升职都和一般公司一样。
zh..gap: 先去海外打工度假一年
zh..gap.s: 约{a}，晚一年开始工作。幸福感 +5。
zh..gap.h: 技能 +2；公司对晚入职的人稍微没那么照顾。

zht..x: 日本企業每年四月統一錄用應屆畢業生。大三大四都在求職：企業說明會、黑色西裝、筆試和一輪又一輪的面試。大公司很少裁員，薪水按年資上漲，但錯過這個時機，大門就很難再開啟。
zht..big.s: 西裝、路費和考試約{a}，面試好幾個月。幸福感 −3。
zht..big.h: 在大公司被裁員的機會小得多，薪水略高，但升職慢。
zht..small: 中小企業和創業公司也投
zht..small.h: 裁員和升職都和一般公司一樣。
zht..gap: 先去海外打工度假一年
zht..gap.s: 約{a}，晚一年開始工作。幸福感 +5。
zht..gap.h: 技能 +2；公司對晚入職的人稍微沒那麼照顧。

events.src: Overtime: since 2019 capped at 45 hours a month and 360 a year (720 with special agreements); 80 hours a month is the government's overwork-illness line; overtime pays at least 25% extra (MHLW, Work Style Reform). Effects are game rules.

opts.do: tmpPay('jp_overtime', 1.15, 5, 'trk.jp_overtime'); rec('', 0, 5, -1.5); grindY += 3; happy -= 3
ppM = (ppM || 1) * .9; happy += 1
bump('jp_calm', .97, M('trk.jp_calm')); happy += 3

en..x: Since 2019 overtime is capped at 45 hours a month and 360 a year (720 with special agreements), but your team often works close to 80 hours of overtime a month, the level the government links to overwork illness. Overtime is paid at least 25% extra.
en..stay.s: About 15% more pay for five years. Happiness −3.
en..stay.h: Health −1.5 a year for five years.
en..move: Ask to move to a calmer team

zh..x: 从2019年起加班上限为每月45小时、每年360小时（特别协议下720小时），但你的团队常常每月加班近80小时，正是政府认定过劳致病的界线。加班费至少多付25%。
zh..stay.s: 五年内工资多约15%。幸福感 −3。
zh..move: 申请调到轻松一点的部门

zht..x: 從2019年起加班上限為每月45小時、每年360小時（特別協議下720小時），但你的團隊常常每月加班近80小時，正是政府認定過勞致病的界線。加班費至少多付25%。
zht..stay.s: 五年內薪水多約15%。幸福感 −3。
zht..move: 申請調到輕鬆一點的部門

events.src: New NISA (from 2024): up to ¥3.6 million a year and ¥18 million in a lifetime, tax-free (FSA, via Daiwa and Rakuten Securities). iDeCo is locked until 60 and contributions are deductible; the tax saving (about 15% with resident tax) is an ESTIMATE.

opts.do: yearly('nisa', { amt: a, until: age + 25 }, {}, 'trk.nisa')
yearly('ideco', { amt: a, until: 60, bonus: .15 }, { lock: 60 }, 'trk.ideco')

en..x: The new NISA (since 2024) lets you invest up to ¥3.6 million a year, ¥18 million in a lifetime, with no tax on the gains. iDeCo, a private pension, is locked until 60, but what you put in comes off your taxable income. Many families keep their savings in deposits that pay almost nothing.
en..nisa.s: About {a} a year for 25 years. About 5% a year after inflation on average, with crashes along the way.
en..ideco.s: The same amount, locked until 60. Your taxes fall by about {b} a year.

zh..x: 新NISA（2024年起）每年最多可投资360万日元，终身1,800万日元，收益免税。私人养老金iDeCo要锁到60岁，但存进去的钱可以抵税。很多家庭把积蓄放在几乎没有利息的存款里。
zh..nisa.s: 每年约{a}，投25年。扣除通胀后平均每年约5%，中途会遇到股灾。
zh..ideco.s: 同样的金额，锁到60岁。每年少缴约{b}的税。

zht..x: 新NISA（2024年起）每年最多可投資360萬日元，終身1,800萬日元，收益免稅。私人退休金iDeCo要鎖到60歲，但存進去的錢可以抵稅。很多家庭把積蓄放在幾乎沒有利息的存款裡。
zht..nisa: 每月定期定額NISA指數基金
zht..nisa.s: 每年約{a}，投25年。扣除通膨後平均每年約5%，中途會遇到股災。
zht..ideco.s: 同樣的金額，鎖到60歲。每年少繳約{b}的稅。

events.src: Furusato nōzei: donations to towns come off income and resident tax except ¥2,000, within a limit; return gifts are capped at 30% of the donation (Ministry of Internal Affairs rules since June 2019). A ¥120,000 donation ≈ 0.05 of the game's typical wage (¥2.47 million), so gifts ≈ 0.014 a year after the ¥2,000.

opts.do: T('jp_furusato', { kind: 'custom', label: M('trk.jp_furusato') }); rec('jp_furusato', -.014 * B, 15); happy += 1
cash += .014 * B; happy += 1

en..x: Furusato nōzei: donate to any town in Japan and, within your limit, all but ¥2,000 comes off your taxes. Towns send thank-you gifts worth up to 30% of the donation, like rice, fruit or beef.
en..yearly.s: Donate about {a} a year; almost all of it comes back as lower tax, plus gifts worth about {b}. Happiness +1.
en..once.s: Donate about {a} this year for gifts worth about {b}. Happiness +1.
en..skip.s: Your taxes stay as they are.

zh..x: 故乡纳税：在额度内捐款给日本任何一个市町村，除了2,000日元，其余都能抵税。地方还会寄回价值最多为捐款30%的回礼，比如大米、水果或牛肉。
zh..yearly.s: 每年捐约{a}；几乎全部能抵税，还有价值约{b}的回礼。幸福感 +1。
zh..once.s: 今年捐约{a}，换价值约{b}的回礼。幸福感 +1。

zht..x: 故鄉納稅：在額度內捐款給日本任何一個市町村，除了2,000日元，其餘都能抵稅。地方還會寄回價值最多為捐款30%的回禮，比如大米、水果或牛肉。
zht..yearly.s: 每年捐約{a}；幾乎全部能抵稅，還有價值約{b}的回禮。幸福感 +1。
zht..once.s: 今年捐約{a}，換價值約{b}的回禮。幸福感 +1。

events.src: Family care: care leave of up to 93 days per family member at 67% of pay from employment insurance (MHLW); long-term care insurance users pay 10–30%; about 104,000 people left work to give care in FY2023 (MHLW, reported via financial-field.com). Service and care-home costs are ESTIMATES.

opts.do: if (working()) tmpPay('jp_kaigoL', .92, 1, 'trk.jp_kaigoL'); T('jp_kaigo', { kind: 'custom', label: M('trk.jp_kaigo') }); rec('jp_kaigo', .04 * B, 6)
endCareer('quit', age - 1); jobAt = age + 3; happy -= 3; T('jp_kaigo', { kind: 'custom', label: M('trk.jp_kaigo') }); rec('jp_kaigo', .01 * B, 3)
T('jp_kaigo', { kind: 'custom', label: M('trk.jp_kaigoH') }); rec('jp_kaigo', .15 * B, 5)

en..x: One of your parents now needs daily care. Long-term care insurance pays most of the cost of home help and day services (you pay 10–30%), and workers can take up to 93 days of care leave at 67% of their pay. About 100,000 people a year leave their jobs to care for family.
en..leave: Take care leave and arrange services
en..leave.s: Three months at 67% of pay, then about {a} a year for your share of the services.
en..quit: Leave your job to care for them
en..quit.s: You can look for work again in about three years. Happiness −3.
en..nojob: You don’t have a job to leave.
en..home.s: About {a} a year (public homes have long waiting lists).

zh..x: 你的父亲或母亲现在每天都需要照护。护理保险负担大部分上门照护和日间照护的费用（自付10–30%），员工最多可请93天护理假，领67%的工资。每年约有10万人为照顾家人辞职。
zh..leave: 请护理假，安排照护服务
zh..leave.s: 三个月领67%的工资，之后服务自付部分每年约{a}。
zh..quit.s: 大约三年后才能再找工作。幸福感 −3。
zh..home.s: 每年约{a}（公立养老院要排很久）。

zht..x: 你的父親或母親現在每天都需要照護。護理保險負擔大部分上門照護和日間照護的費用（自付10–30%），員工最多可請93天護理假，領67%的薪水。每年約有10萬人為照顧家人辭職。
zht..leave: 請護理假，安排照護服務
zht..leave.s: 三個月領67%的薪水，之後服務自付部分每年約{a}。
zht..quit.s: 大約三年後才能再找工作。幸福感 −3。
zht..home.s: 每年約{a}（公立安養機構要排很久）。

events.src: Akiya: 9.0 million empty homes in Oct 2023, 13.8% of all homes (Housing and Land Survey 2023, via Jiji); since 27 Apr 2023 inherited land can be handed to the state for a fee of usually ¥200,000 (≈ 0.08), the building torn down first (Ministry of Justice). Upkeep, demolition and sale prices are ESTIMATES.

opts.do: T('jp_akiya', { kind: 'custom', label: M('trk.jp_akiya') }); rec('jp_akiya', .05 * B, 15); happy += 1; later(age + 2 + Math.floor(roll('akiyaAt') * 8), 'akiya', {})
const v = inR(roll('akiyaSell'), [0, .6]) * B; cash += v; const t = T('jp_akiya', { kind: 'custom', label: M('trk.jp_akiyaS'), v }); t.note = M('note.got', { a: MN(v) })
const c = .58 * B; pay(c); const t = T('jp_akiya', { kind: 'custom', label: M('trk.jp_akiyaG'), v: -c }); t.note = M('note.paid', { a: MN(c) })

later.akiya: if (roll('akiyaBuy') < .3) { const v = .4 * base; cash += v; stopRec('jp_akiya'); const t = trk.jp_akiya; if (t) { t.v += v; t.note = M('note.akiyaSold', { a: MN(v) }); } log(M('log.akiyaSold', { a: MN(v) }), 'good'); }

en..x: You inherit your parents’ old house in the countryside. Japan had 9 million empty homes in 2023, 13.8% of all homes. Since April 2023 you can hand inherited land to the state for a fee of usually ¥200,000, once the building is torn down.
en..keep.s: About {a} a year in tax and upkeep. Happiness +1.
en..sell: Sell it for what you can get
en..sell.h: Old rural houses often sell for very little.
en..state: Tear it down and hand the land to the state
en..state.s: Demolition about {a}, plus the fee ({b}). No more costs after that.

zh..x: 你继承了父母在乡下的老房子。2023年日本有900万间空屋，占所有住宅的13.8%。从2023年4月起，拆掉房屋后，你可以把继承的土地交给国家，一般缴20万日元的负担金。
zh..keep.s: 每年税金和维护约{a}。幸福感 +1。
zh..sell.h: 乡下的老房子常常卖不了几个钱。
zh..state.s: 拆除约{a}，加上负担金{b}。之后不再有任何费用。

zht..x: 你繼承了父母在鄉下的老房子。2023年日本有900萬間空屋，佔所有住宅的13.8%。從2023年4月起，拆掉房屋後，你可以把繼承的土地交給國家，一般繳20萬日元的負擔金。
zht..keep.s: 每年稅金和維護約{a}。幸福感 +1。
zht..sell.h: 鄉下的老房子常常賣不了幾個錢。
zht..state.s: 拆除約{a}，加上負擔金{b}。之後不再有任何費用。

events.src: Pension timing: claim from 60 to 75; each month early cuts 0.4% (−24% at 60), each month late adds 0.7% (+42% at 70, +84% at 75), for those born from 2 Apr 1962 (Japan Pension Service rules since April 2022, via President Online and Daiwa Institute).

opts.do: penClaim(q[0], q[1], 'jp_nenkin')

en..x: You can start your public pension at any age from 60 to 75. Each month earlier cuts it by 0.4% for life (24% less at 60); each month later adds 0.7% (42% more at 70, 84% more at 75).
en..60.s: About {a} a year from age {n}, for life.
en..65.s: About {a} a year from age {n}, for life.
en..70.s: About {a} a year from age {n}, for life.
en..75.s: About {a} a year from age {n}, for life.

zh..x: 公共年金可以在60到75岁之间任何时候开始领。每提前一个月，终身减少0.4%（60岁领少24%）；每推迟一个月，增加0.7%（70岁多42%，75岁多84%）。
zh..60.s: 从{n}岁起每年约{a}，终身领取。
zh..65.s: 从{n}岁起每年约{a}，终身领取。
zh..70.s: 从{n}岁起每年约{a}，终身领取。
zh..75.s: 从{n}岁起每年约{a}，终身领取。

zht..x: 公共年金可以在60到75歲之間任何時候開始領。每提前一個月，終身減少0.4%（60歲領少24%）；每推遲一個月，增加0.7%（70歲多42%，75歲多84%）。
zht..60.s: 從{n}歲起每年約{a}，終身領取。
zht..65.s: 從{n}歲起每年約{a}，終身領取。
zht..70.s: 從{n}歲起每年約{a}，終身領取。
zht..75.s: 從{n}歲起每年約{a}，終身領取。

events.src: Earthquake insurance: government-backed, up to 50% of the fire-insurance amount; 69.4% of fire policies included it in FY2022 (General Insurance Rating Organization of Japan, via financial-field.com). The chance of a damaging quake is Japan’s rate of people affected by earthquakes a year, 2000–2024, from EM-DAT (js/data.js); premiums and the damage are ESTIMATES.

opts.do: T('jp_quakeI', { kind: 'custom', label: M('trk.jp_quakeI') }); rec('jp_quakeI', .007 * base, 20); q(1)

later.quake: if (!house || roll('quake') >= disP(20, 'quake')) return; const d = .25 * house.value, cov = x.ins ? .5 * d : 0; pay(d - cov); happy -= 5; const t = T('jp_quake', { kind: 'custom', label: M('trk.jp_quake') }); t.v -= d - cov; t.note = M('note.quake', { a: MN(d), b: MN(cov) }); log(M('log.quake', { a: MN(d), b: MN(cov) }), 'bad')

en..x: Your home insurance offers earthquake cover, backed by the government, for up to 50% of the amount your home is insured for. In 2022, 69% of fire-insurance policies included it.
en..add.h: A strong quake is unlikely in any one year; the cover pays half the damage.
en..skip.h: A strong quake is unlikely in any one year, but the damage can be large.

zh..x: 你的房屋保险可以加保由政府支持的地震险，最多保到火灾保险金额的50%。2022年有69%的火灾保险加保了地震险。
zh..add.h: 某一年遇到大地震的机会不大；保险会赔一半损失。
zh..skip.h: 某一年遇到大地震的机会不大，但损失可能很大。

zht..x: 你的房屋保險可以加保由政府支援的地震險，最多保到火災保險金額的50%。2022年有69%的火災保險加保了地震險。
zht..add.h: 某一年遇到大地震的機會不大；保險會賠一半損失。
zht..skip.h: 某一年遇到大地震的機會不大，但損失可能很大。

events.src: Non-regular work: 36.8% of employees were non-regular (part-time, contract or dispatched) in 2024 (Labour Force Survey, MIC), and their average monthly pay was about 67% of regular employees’ (¥233,100 against ¥348,600), rising little with age (Basic Survey on Wage Structure 2024, MHLW). The pay and layoff multiples used here are an ESTIMATE.

opts.do: tmpPay('jp_haken', 1.15, 4, 'trk.jp_haken'); layM = (layM || 1) * 1.5; later(age + 4, 'jp_hakenEnd', {})
layM = (layM || 1) * .7

en..x: Two offers: a regular job (seishain) at a small firm, or better-paid dispatched work at a big company in Tokyo on a renewable contract.
en..haken.s: Higher hourly pay, contracts renewed every few months.
en..haken.h: Pay about 15% higher for four years, then it falls behind; contracts are easier to end.
en..regular.s: Lower starting pay, a yearly raise and a bonus.
en..regular.h: Regular staff are rarely let go.
en.log.jp_hk: Your dispatch contracts keep being renewed, but the pay hasn’t moved while your friends in regular jobs got raises.

zh..x: 你有两个机会：一家小公司的正式员工，或是东京大公司的派遣工作，薪水较高，合约一期一期续。
zh..haken.s: 时薪较高，合约每几个月续一次。
zh..haken.h: 头四年薪水大约高15%，之后就落后了；合约也比较容易被终止。
zh..regular.s: 起薪较低，每年调薪，还有奖金。
zh.log.jp_hk: 你的派遣合约一直续约，薪水却没涨，而当正式员工的朋友都加薪了。

zht..x: 你有兩個機會：一家小公司的正職，或是東京大公司的派遣工作，薪水較高，合約一期一期續。
zht..haken.s: 時薪較高，合約每幾個月續一次。
zht..haken.h: 頭四年薪水大約高15%，之後就落後了；合約也比較容易被終止。
zht..regular.s: 起薪較低，每年調薪，還有獎金。
zht.log.jp_hk: 你的派遣合約一直續約，薪水卻沒漲，而當正職的朋友都加薪了。

events.src: Juku for private junior high entrance exams cost about ¥2.1–2.6 million over the three years before the exam at the big chains (2023 reports, via Agaroot and Inter-Edu); about 52,300 children sat private and national junior high exams in the Tokyo area in 2025 (Shutoken Moshi Center). ¥800,000 a year ≈ 0.32 of the game’s typical wage. Bursary odds are an ESTIMATE.

opts.do: T('jp_juku', {kind: 'custom', label: M('trk.jp_juku')}); rec('jp_juku', .32 * base, 3); kidWin(.25, .7); bond('kid', -2); happy -= 1
T('jp_juku', {kind: 'custom', label: M('trk.jp_juku2')}); rec('jp_juku', .08 * base, 3); kidWin(.1, .85)
bond('kid', 2)

en..x: Half your child’s class is starting cram school for private junior high entrance exams. Classes run three evenings a week and all weekend.
en..juku.s: About {a} a year for three years.
en..juku.h: Long hours for your child and you. Many pass a private school’s exam; good schools can lead to scholarships.
en..local.h: A small chance of a scholarship later.
en..none: The local public school is fine

zh..x: 孩子班上一半同学都开始上补习班，准备考私立初中。每周三个晚上，加上整个周末。
zh..juku.h: 孩子和你都很辛苦。很多人能考上私立学校；好学校以后可能拿到奖学金。
zh..local.h: 以后有一点机会拿奖学金。
zh..none: 念附近的公立学校就好

zht..x: 孩子班上一半同學都開始上補習班，準備考私立國中。每週三個晚上，加上整個週末。
zht..juku.h: 孩子和你都很辛苦。很多人能考上私立學校；好學校以後可能拿到獎學金。
zht..local.h: 以後有一點機會拿獎學金。
zht..none: 念附近的公立學校就好

events.src: Families spent about ¥1.56 million a year on a private junior high pupil against about ¥540,000 for a public one (MEXT Survey of Children’s Learning Expenses, FY2023). The difference (≈ ¥1 million ≈ 0.4 of the game’s typical wage) and its effects are an ESTIMATE.

opts.do: T('jp_shi', {kind: 'custom', label: M('trk.jp_shi')}); rec('jp_shi', .4 * base, 6); kidWin(.2, .75); happy += 1
bond('kid', -1)

en..x: Your child passed the entrance exam for a private junior and senior high school.
en..private.s: About {a} a year more than public school, for six years.
en..private.h: Happiness +1; a better shot at a scholarship later.
en..public.s: Three years of juku, and no private fees.

zh..x: 孩子考上了一所私立的初高中一贯制学校。
zh..private.s: 六年里每年比公立学校多大约{a}。
zh..private.h: 幸福感 +1；以后拿奖学金的机会大一些。
zh..public.s: 补了三年习，但不用付私立学费。

zht..x: 孩子考上了一所私立的國高中一貫制學校。
zht..private.s: 六年裡每年比公立學校多大約{a}。
zht..private.h: 幸福感 +1；以後拿獎學金的機會大一些。
zht..public.s: 補了三年習，但不用付私立學費。

events.src: Transfers (tenkin) are common at large Japanese firms, and many married employees move alone (tanshin funin), keeping the family home where the children are at school. The transfer allowance, the second household’s cost and the career effects are an ESTIMATE.

opts.do: tmpPay('jp_tenkin', 1.1, 3, 'trk.jp_tenkin'); T('jp_tanshin', {kind: 'custom', label: M('trk.jp_tanshin')}); rec('jp_tanshin', .1 * base, 3); bond('pt', -4); bond('kid', -3); rl(-3); happy -= 2
spend('jp_move', .1 * base, 'trk.jp_move'); bump('jp_tenkin2', 1.03, M('trk.jp_tenkin2')); bond('kid', -1); happy -= 1
bump('jp_tenkinNo', .95, M('trk.jp_tenkinNo')); happy += 1

en..x: Your company is transferring you to a branch in another city for at least three years. Your children are settled at school here.
en..alone.s: A small flat there; home at weekends when you can.
en..alone.h: A transfer allowance, but two households to run; the family drifts a little. Happiness −2.
en..family.s: About {a} in moving costs not covered.
en..family.h: Your career keeps moving; the children have to start over.
en..refuse.h: Promotions come slower: pay about 5% lower for good. Happiness +1.
en.trk.jp_tanshin: A second home for the transfer

zh..x: 公司要把你调到外地分公司，至少三年。孩子在这里的学校已经适应了。
zh..alone.s: 在那边租个小房间；能回家就周末回。
zh..alone.h: 有调职津贴，但要负担两个家；跟家人有点疏远。幸福感 −2。
zh..family.s: 搬家费有大约{a}公司不付。
zh..family.h: 事业继续往上走；孩子得重新适应。
zh..refuse.h: 升迁变慢：薪水永久低大约5%。幸福感 +1。

zht..x: 公司要把你調到外地分公司，至少三年。孩子在這裡的學校已經適應了。
zht..alone.s: 在那邊租個小房間；能回家就週末回。
zht..alone.h: 有調職津貼，但要負擔兩個家；跟家人有點疏遠。幸福感 −2。
zht..family.s: 搬家費有大約{a}公司不付。
zht..family.h: 事業繼續往上走；孩子得重新適應。
zht..refuse.h: 升遷變慢：薪水永久低大約5%。幸福感 +1。

events.src: Childcare leave: employment insurance pays 67% of pay for the first 180 days and 50% after, tax-free and without social insurance premiums; from April 2025 it tops up to 80% (about all of take-home pay) for up to 28 days when both parents take leave (MHLW). 40.5% of fathers and 86.6% of mothers took leave in FY2024 (Basic Survey of Equal Employment Management, MHLW). Career and family effects are an ESTIMATE.

opts.do: tmpPay('jp_ikukyu', .67, 1, 'trk.jp_ikukyu'); bond('kid', 6); bond('pt', 3); happy += 2
bond('kid', 2); happy += 1
bond('pt', -2); happy -= 1

en..x: Your baby has arrived. You can take childcare leave, paid by employment insurance, though few people in your team have taken much.
en..long.s: About two-thirds of your pay, tax-free.
en..long.h: Happiness +2; you grow much closer to your child and partner.
en..none.h: Happiness −1; your partner carries most of it.

zh..x: 宝宝出生了。你可以请育儿假，由雇佣保险发津贴，不过你们部门很少有人请很久。
zh..long.s: 大约三分之二的薪水，免税。
zh..long.h: 幸福感 +2；跟孩子和伴侣都亲近很多。
zh..none.h: 幸福感 −1；大部分都落在伴侣身上。

zht..x: 寶寶出生了。你可以請育嬰假，由就業保險發津貼，不過你們部門很少有人請很久。
zht..long.s: 大約三分之二的薪水，免稅。
zht..long.h: 幸福感 +2；跟孩子和伴侶都親近很多。
zht..none.h: 幸福感 −1；大部分都落在伴侶身上。

events.src: Mortgage rates: most Japanese borrowers chose variable rates of about 0.5–1% at online banks, against about 2% fixed for 35 years (Flat 35) in 2025; the Bank of Japan raised its policy rate in steps from −0.1% (March 2024) to about 1% (June 2026), and banks raised variable rates again in October 2026 (Business Insider Japan; 77 Bank, Oct 2026). Variable payments are usually reset every five years. The real rates used (0.3% variable, 1.2% fixed) and the later rise are an ESTIMATE.

opts.ok: liq >= .13 * P || M('e.home.need', { n: MN(.13 * P), h: MN(liq) })
opts.do: buyAt(P, { dp: .1, fee: .03, r: .003, n: 35, lk: 'trk.jp_var' })

opts.ok: liq >= .13 * P || M('e.home.need', { n: MN(.13 * P), h: MN(liq) })
opts.do: buyAt(P, { dp: .1, fee: .03, r: .012, n: 35, lk: 'trk.jp_fix', fixed: true })

en..x: You’ve found a flat you like. An online bank offers a variable-rate mortgage at under 1%; a 35-year fixed loan costs about 2%.
en..var: Buy it with a variable-rate loan
en..var.s: About {a} down with costs; the lowest payments today.
en..var.h: Rates have started to rise; payments can go up.
en..fix: Buy it with a 35-year fixed loan
en..fix.s: About {a} down with costs; higher payments that never change.
en..fix.h: You pay more now for certainty.
en.trk.jp_var: A flat on a variable-rate loan
en.trk.jp_fix: A flat on a fixed-rate loan

zh..t: 浮动利率还是固定利率？
zh..x: 你看中了一间公寓。网络银行的浮动利率房贷不到1%；35年固定利率大约2%。
zh..var.s: 头期款加费用大约{a}；现在月付最低。
zh..var.h: 利率已经开始上升；月付可能会变高。
zh..fix.s: 头期款加费用大约{a}；月付较高，但永远不变。
zh..fix.h: 现在多付一点，换来安心。

zht..t: 浮動利率還是固定利率？
zht..x: 你看中了一間公寓。網路銀行的浮動利率房貸不到1%；35年固定利率大約2%。
zht..var.s: 頭期款加費用大約{a}；現在月付最低。
zht..var.h: 利率已經開始上升；月付可能會變高。
zht..fix.s: 頭期款加費用大約{a}；月付較高，但永遠不變。
zht..fix.h: 現在多付一點，換來安心。

events.src: As the Bank of Japan raised rates, banks raised variable mortgage rates by about 0.25% each time (2024–2026); payments rise at the five-yearly reset, capped at 125% of the old payment (the “125% rule”, which defers rather than forgives interest). Sizes are an ESTIMATE.

opts.do: house.pay = house.pay * 1.15; happy -= 1
pay(.01 * house.mort); house.pay = house.pay * 1.25; house.fixed = true

en..x: The bank writes: your variable rate is rising, and your payments will be reset next year.
en..keep.s: Payments go up now, and may go up again.
en..fix.s: About {a} in fees; higher payments that won’t change.
en..fix.h: About 25% more a year, fixed for good.

zh..x: 银行来信：你的浮动利率要调高，明年起月付会重新计算。
zh..keep.s: 月付现在就涨，以后可能再涨。
zh..fix.s: 手续费大约{a}；月付较高，但不会再变。

zht..x: 銀行來信：你的浮動利率要調高，明年起月付會重新計算。
zht..keep.s: 月付現在就漲，以後可能再漲。
zht..fix.s: 手續費大約{a}；月付較高，但不會再變。

events.src: Investment studio flats sold by cold call to young workers, often on 35-year loans with a “rent guarantee” (sublease) whose rent can be cut, are a frequent consumer complaint: complaints from people in their 20s rose from 160 in FY2013 to 405 in FY2018 (National Consumer Affairs Center, Mar 2019), and the Tokyo Consumer Center warns that guaranteed rents are often lowered mid-contract (2020). Cash flows and the flat’s value are an ESTIMATE.

opts.do: T('jp_1rC', {kind: 'custom', label: M('trk.jp_1rC')}); rec('jp_1rC', .06 * base, 35); later(age + 35, 'jp_1rEnd', {})

en..x: A salesman calls you at work: a new studio flat in Tokyo, on a 35-year loan with no money down. The rent is guaranteed, he says, and it is “a pension you build with the bank’s money”.
en..buy.s: The rent covers most of the loan; you add about {a} a year.
en..buy.h: These flats are sold above their value, and guaranteed rents are often cut later.
en.log.jp_1r: The loan on your investment flat is finally paid off. The flat is old now.

zh..x: 有个业务打到公司找你：东京的新建套房，35年贷款，零头期款。他说租金有保证，是“用银行的钱帮自己存退休金”。
zh..buy.s: 租金能付大部分贷款；你每年再补大约{a}。
zh..buy.h: 这种套房卖价高于实际价值，保证租金以后常常会被调降。
zh.log.jp_1r: 投资套房的贷款终于还完了。房子也旧了。

zht..x: 有個業務打到公司找你：東京的新建套房，35年貸款，零頭期款。他說租金有保證，是「用銀行的錢幫自己存退休金」。
zht..buy.s: 租金能付大部分貸款；你每年再補大約{a}。
zht..buy.h: 這種套房賣價高於實際價值，保證租金以後常常會被調降。
zht.log.jp_1r: 投資套房的貸款終於還完了。房子也舊了。

events.src: Sublease companies may lower guaranteed rents during the contract (Consumer Affairs Agency; MLIT, 2018–2020). Selling early often means paying off a loan larger than the flat’s price. Sizes are an ESTIMATE.

opts.do: T('jp_1rC', {kind: 'custom', label: M('trk.jp_1rC')}); rec('jp_1rC', .06 * base, 30); happy -= 1
stopRec('jp_1rC'); pay(base); const tq = T('jp_1rC', {kind: 'custom', label: M('trk.jp_1rC')}); tq.v -= base; happy -= 2

en..x: The sublease company says the “guaranteed” rent will be cut by 15%. You now pay twice as much each year to keep the loan going.
en..keep.h: About twice the yearly top-up; the flat is yours when the loan ends.
en..sell.s: The flat sells for less than the loan: about {a} to make up.

zh..x: 包租公司说“保证”租金要降15%。你每年要补的钱变成两倍。
zh..keep.h: 每年补贴大约变两倍；贷款还完房子就是你的。
zh..sell.s: 卖价比贷款低：大约要补{a}。

zht..x: 包租公司說「保證」租金要降15%。你每年要補的錢變成兩倍。
zht..keep.h: 每年補貼大約變兩倍；貸款還完房子就是你的。
zht..sell.s: 賣價比貸款低：大約要補{a}。

events.src: Marriage agencies (kekkon sōdanjo) charge about ¥300,000–500,000 in the first year in joining and monthly fees, and dating apps a few thousand yen a month (agency and app price lists, 2025: ESTIMATE). How much each raises the chance of meeting someone is a game rule.

opts.do: spend('jp_kon', .16 * base, 'trk.jp_kon'); look = age; happy -= 1
spend('jp_kon', .015 * base, 'trk.jp_kon'); if (roll('jp_konkatsu') < .5) look = age

en..x: Your friends are getting married one after another, and your mother keeps sending you brochures from marriage agencies.
en..agency.h: A much better chance of meeting someone this year. Happiness −1 from all the meetings.

zh..x: 朋友一个接一个结婚，妈妈一直寄婚友社的简介给你。
zh..agency.h: 今年遇到对象的机会大很多。见面太多，幸福感 −1。

zht..x: 朋友一個接一個結婚，媽媽一直寄婚友社的簡介給你。
zht..agency.h: 今年遇到對象的機會大很多。見面太多，幸福感 −1。

events.src: Retirement allowances: university graduates retiring after long service received about ¥19 million on average (MHLW General Survey on Working Conditions, 2023); banks court new retirees with “retirement allowance plans” that pair a high-rate deposit for a few months with investment trusts carrying high fees, and the FSA has urged customer-first sales. The allowance (taken as 2.5 years’ pay, at most 8 typical wages) and the 2% a year fees are an ESTIMATE.

opts.do: cash += a; const tq = T('jp_taishoku', {kind: 'custom', label: M('trk.jp_taishoku')}); tq.v += a; putIn('jp_bank', .5 * a, {fee: .02}, 'trk.jp_bank'); happy += 1
cash += a; const tq = T('jp_taishoku', {kind: 'custom', label: M('trk.jp_taishoku')}); tq.v += a; putIn('jp_idx', .5 * a, {}, 'trk.jp_idx')
cash += a; const tq = T('jp_taishoku', {kind: 'custom', label: M('trk.jp_taishoku')}); tq.v += a

en..x: Your company pays your retirement allowance: {a}. The next day your bank calls about its special plan for retirees.
en..bank.s: Half, {a}, into a special deposit and the bank’s funds.
en..bank.h: Happiness +1; the funds charge about 2% a year.
en..index: Half into a low-cost index fund
en..index.s: {a}, through your NISA and an ordinary account.
en..index.h: Grows with the market, with low fees.
en..keep: Keep it in your savings account

zh..x: 公司发给你一笔退职金：{a}。第二天银行就打电话来推销退休族专案。
zh..bank.s: 一半，{a}，放进特别定存和银行的基金。
zh..bank.h: 幸福感 +1；基金每年收费大约2%。
zh..index: 一半买低成本指数基金

zht..x: 公司發給你一筆退職金：{a}。第二天銀行就打電話來推銷退休族專案。
zht..bank.s: 一半，{a}，放進特別定存和銀行的基金。
zht..bank.h: 幸福感 +1；基金每年收費大約2%。
zht..index: 一半買低成本指數基金

events.src: Public health insurance pays 70% of bills, and the high-cost medical expense benefit caps what a middle earner pays at about ¥80,100 a month plus 1% of costs above ¥267,000 (MHLW), so private medical insurance pays out less than many expect. Premiums (¥8,000 a month ≈ 0.04 a year; cancer cover ¥2,500 ≈ 0.012) and the share of bills saved are an ESTIMATE.

opts.do: T('jp_hoken', {kind: 'ghost', label: M('trk.jp_hoken')}); rec('jp_hoken', .04 * base, 30); medCut = (medCut || 1) * .9; happy += 1
T('jp_hoken', {kind: 'ghost', label: M('trk.jp_hokenC')}); rec('jp_hoken', .012 * base, 30); medCut = (medCut || 1) * .95

en..x: An insurance saleswoman visits your office at lunch with a medical policy and a cancer policy. “Everyone your age has one,” she says.
en..full.h: Happiness +1 for peace of mind; it pays only a little more than the public cap already saves.
en..cancer.h: Pays a lump sum if you are diagnosed.
en..public.h: The monthly cap already limits big bills.

zh..x: 午休时，保险业务员来公司推销医疗险和癌症险。她说：“你这个年纪的人都有一份。”
zh..full.h: 安心一点，幸福感 +1；但它比公家医疗的上限多赔不了多少。
zh..cancer.h: 确诊时一次给付一笔钱。
zh..public.h: 每月的自付上限已经挡住大笔账单。

zht..x: 午休時，保險業務員來公司推銷醫療險和癌症險。她說：「你這個年紀的人都有一份。」
zht..full.h: 安心一點，幸福感 +1；但它比公家醫療的上限多賠不了多少。
zht..cancer.h: 確診時一次給付一筆錢。
zht..public.h: 每月的自付上限已經擋住大筆帳單。

events.src: Moving or closing a family grave (kaisō, “hakajimai”) has doubled in ten years, from about 84,000 cases in FY2014 to about 176,000 in FY2024 (MHLW Report on Public Health Administration, cited in a Cabinet Office review); costs run from ¥300,000 to ¥3 million (consumer guides: ESTIMATE). Keeping a distant grave means temple fees and trips home. ¥1 million ≈ 0.4 of the game’s typical wage.

opts.do: spend('jp_haka', .4 * base, 'trk.jp_haka'); happy += 1
T('jp_haka2', {kind: 'custom', label: M('trk.jp_haka2')}); rec('jp_haka2', .03 * base, 20)

en..x: Your family grave is at a temple in your parents’ hometown, a long train ride away. Nobody lives there any more, and the temple asks who will look after it.
en..close.s: About {a} for the temple, the stonemason and a new place.
en..keep: Keep the grave where it is
en..keep.s: Temple fees and a trip every Obon: about {a} a year.

zh..x: 家族的坟在爸妈老家的寺庙里，坐火车要很久。那里已经没有家人住了，寺庙问以后谁来照顾。
zh..close.s: 寺庙、石匠和新墓地大约{a}。
zh..keep.s: 寺庙费用加上每年盂兰盆节回去一趟：每年大约{a}。

zht..x: 家族的墓在爸媽老家的寺廟裡，坐火車要很久。那裡已經沒有家人住了，寺廟問以後誰來照顧。
zht..close.s: 寺廟、石匠和新墓地大約{a}。
zht..keep.s: 寺廟費用加上每年盂蘭盆節回去一趟：每年大約{a}。
